title: It wasn't obvious upfront that returning the Hollow King's crown (to rest him deeper) would later lock out the 'sit the hollow seat with a crown' option at the Hollow Throne — the tradeoff between early-game and end-game crown uses isn't flagged until you reach the final room and 'weigh the doors' tells you what you lack.
